notes: memory_limit is an approximate total process-memory target, not an enforced ceiling; no OS-level cap is installed.
Trace extraction processes one time partition at a time by design, so the worker dimension is exercised through the graph-executed projection path.
Peak RSS is a whole-process high-water mark for the configuration's own subprocess.
